reviews.title: Game changer!  From rehome to welcome home!
reviews.body: These are a game changer!  I have a male Rottweiler that has taken up the habit of marking everything in the house if left alone.  I have tried retraining, calming chews, the pheromone diffusers....  Nothing has worked.  These were my last effort before I seriously considered rehoming him.  They are amazing!  They work to not only keep him from marking, but if he does, they trap the urine!  He's learning he doesn't like the wet feeling so just after a few days of use, I'm noticing the wraps aren't as wet anymore.  They're super easy to throw in the washing machine.  The Velcro is super strong.  They stay in place.  I'm actually purchasing more!
reviews.date: Reseñado en Estados Unidos el 21 de agosto de 2026

reviews.title: Absolutely fantastic product !!!
reviews.body: Thank you for not only saving my sanity but more importantly for giving my dog the first day in weeks without being constantly wet and in discomfort !!! The belly bands arrived this morning and for the first time in a months , I have not had to constantly mop up floors and exhaust my washing machine with load after load of towels and or continuously shower my very large dog. I was tearing my hair out trying to find belly bands that would fit him as he is very very large, until I came across these. They are extremely good quality and fit extremely well. They hold a lot of liquid with no seepage at all and believe me, being such a large dog, he produces a lot of liquid! I ordered them on Sunday evening with express delivery. The estimated delivery time was 5-7days from the USA to the UK. They arrived this morning , Wednesday, less than 72 hours from ordering! Fantastic service. Whats more they came as a pack of 3 so absolutely amazing value for money. I am so glad I bought these.
